assessments.reasoning: I independently retrieved and verified the exact bytes of A Sublanguage of ALGOL 68 and inspected the cited passage (§§0.2 and 1.1, physical PDF p. 1). Hibbard §0.2 establishes the addendum context. Section 1.1 explicitly excludes UNITED-declarers and permits calls to standard-prelude routines with a parameter mode enveloping a union, naming print and upb.

challenge.method: Compare declaring a user-level union, calling the permitted standard-prelude routines, and using features described in the expanded PDP11 manual.
challenge.results: The formal text distinguishes banned declarers from the permitted prelude calls. The PDP11 implementation is an extended language and supplies no counterexample to the formal scope.

limitations: The exception concerns the standard-prelude call form described by Hibbard.
